questions.question: Is it mandatory to have .NET installed to run a .NET application (.dll/.exe)?
questions.shortAnswer: No, it is not always mandatory. It depends on how the application is deployed.

answerFrom.section: # Is it mandatory to have .NET installed to run a .NET application (.dll/.exe)?

questions.question: Can you set ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT through Windows environment variables, and does changing it need a rebuild?
questions.shortAnswer: Yes, setting `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT` through Windows environment variables is valid. The application reads it at startup, so only a restart is required, not a rebuild.
